RUS_opening_check_popular_anger = {
    RUS = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_active has_government = national_populist RUS_boris_savinkov = { is_country_leader = yes } check_variable = { RUS_popular_anger > 7 } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_revolt_queued } }
        set_country_flag = RUS_opening_revolt_queued
        activate_mission = RUS_opening_resistance_wave
    }
    }
}

RUS_opening_check_military_anger = {
    RUS = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_active has_government = national_populist check_variable = { RUS_military_anger > 4 } }
        set_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_threshold_reached
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_active has_government = national_populist has_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_threshold_reached NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_warning_queued } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_countdown_started } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_wrangel_minister }
            set_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_warning_queued
            log = "RUS opening military warning queued: Wrangel"
            country_event = { id = rus_opening.1 days = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_denikin_minister }
            set_country_flag = RUS_opening_military_warning_queued
            log = "RUS opening military warning queued: Denikin"
            country_event = { id = rus_opening.2 days = 1 }
        }
    }
    }
}

RUS_opening_request_army_minister = {
    RUS = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_minister_queued } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_minister_selected } }
        set_country_flag = RUS_opening_minister_queued
        country_event = { id = russia_events.124 days = 1 }
    }
    }
}

RUS_opening_finish_phase = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_active NOT = { has_government = national_populist } }
        clr_country_flag = RUS_opening_active
        set_country_flag = RUS_opening_finished
        load_focus_tree = { tree = Russia_Focus keep_completed = yes }
        mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
    }
}

RUS_opening_initialise = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = RUS has_government = national_populist NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_opening_initialised } }
		set_country_flag = RUS_opening_initialised
		set_country_flag = RUS_opening_active
		load_focus_tree = { tree = RUS_savinkov_opening_tree keep_completed = yes }
		# Native bypass records completion without a completion popup or reward replay.
		unlock_national_focus = RUS_artelizatsiya
		unlock_national_focus = RUS_voskhod
		add_ideas = RUS_artels
		add_ideas = RUS_opening_unfinished_land_reform
		add_ideas = RUS_opening_disordered_industry
		RUS_select_AEG_nationalisation_states = yes
		activate_targeted_decision = { target = ROOT decision = RUS_increase_funding }
		activate_targeted_decision = { target = ROOT decision = RUS_utilise_army }
		activate_targeted_decision = { target = 516 decision = RUS_norilsk_mining_and_metallurgy }
		activate_targeted_decision = { target = 653 decision = RUS_ural_wagon_factory }
		activate_targeted_decision = { target = 562 decision = RUS_magadan_gold_mining }

	}
